Spines are more obviously at right angles to the coil edge than any other species of the hard-fruited subsection Pachyspireae. Recently, 330 M. truncatula accessions from a germplasm collection were sequenced and have been used for genome-wide association studies such as Stanton-Geddes et al. (2013) and Kang et al. (2015).
